sessionEnd.comment: Prune orphaned Copilot hook configs left by uninstalled/upgraded tools. Runs at sessionEnd, never sessionStart, to keep startup latency at zero. Fails open.
Retention sweep: extension logs older than 7d, session-state older than 60d. Leaves session-store.db alone. Fails open.

Dedupe MCP OAuth cache entries. Duplicate metadata for one serverUrl causes cold-start auth thrash (observed on WorkIQ-Mail-MCP-Server, 2026-06-08). Keeps the freshest non-expired token per serverUrl and archives the rest; never touches tokens-only files, which are the primary cache format for several servers. Moves, never deletes. Fails open.

Re-apply disabled plugin extensions. A plugin update restores extension.mjs and silently re-enables the per-session node fork, so this is enforced every session rather than renamed once. Renames only, never deletes.
